opennyai_summary.decision:
Perused the FIR.
Therefore, till papers are received, interim protection as prayed deserves to be granted.
Hence, the following order :-
 ORDER (i) Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 14.06.2024.
(ii) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicants, namely, (i) Mohammad Anwar Khan and (ii) Abdul Hanif Abdul Aajij in connection with C.R. No.60 of 2024, registered with Shirpur City Police Station, Dist. Dhule for offence punishable under Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)
(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3 read with section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act and under sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with section 34 of Indian Penal Code, they be released on executing Personal Bond and Surety Bond of Rs.15,000/- each, with one surety each in the like amount.
(iii) Applicants shall attend concerned police station on every Monday and Thursday of every month between 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon and shall co-operate in the investigation.
